title: [WIP] Add Chinese version of the documentation
body:
## Plan: Add Chinese (cn) Translations

- [x] Understand the repository structure and i18n configuration
- [x] Create Chinese translation for main index page (index.cn.mdx)
- [x] Create Chinese translations for meta.json files (meta.cn.json)
  - [x] Root docs meta.cn.json
  - [x] Guides meta.cn.json
  - [x] Concepts meta.cn.json
  - [x] Specifications meta.cn.json (root and subcategories)
- [x] Create Chinese translations for guide pages
  - [x] getting-started.cn.mdx
  - [x] installation.cn.mdx
  - [x] project-structure.cn.mdx
- [x] Create Chinese translations for concept pages
  - [x] manifesto.cn.mdx
  - [x] core-values.cn.mdx
  - [x] architecture.cn.mdx
  - [x] enterprise-patterns.cn.mdx
  - [x] terminology.cn.mdx
  - [x] security_architecture.cn.mdx
  - [x] ai-codex.cn.mdx
- [x] Create Chinese translations for specification pages
  - [x] Specifications meta files (all subcategories)
  - [x] Key specification files (architecture files for data/ui/server)
- [ ] Test the documentation site with Chinese translations
- [ ] Code review and final verification

**Note:** The `references/` directory is auto-generated from JSON schemas and should NOT be translated as per the requirements.

**Translation Coverage:**
- ✅ Complete: Index, Guides, Concepts, Specification meta files
- ✅ Key pages: All main architecture documents
- ℹ️ Remaining specification pages can be translated as needed in the future
